name: singlet_clustering_resolution_selection
title: Choose clustering resolution without labels
description: Chooses one clustering resolution from a sweep over an existing kNN or SNN graph when no reference labels exist. The default rule, chooser_threshold, applies the chooseR subsample co-clustering robustness rule with a bootstrap silhouette threshold; max_silhouette and label_nmi (a comparator that uses labels) are alternatives, and report_only writes the sweep without selecting. Needs an obsp connectivity graph; writes one partition per grid value, the selected partition (except report_only), a per-resolution summary and the selection record. Do not use it to score a clustering against labels or to obtain a fixed cluster count (use clustering.cell_partitioning), and do not describe a selected resolution as biologically validated.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

graph_key.description: Graph to sweep; reads obsp/<graph_key>_connectivities. The graph is not rebuilt.

embedding_key.description: Cell embedding in obsm, used by max_silhouette and recorded for the other rules.

labels_key.description: Obs column with reference labels. Required by label_nmi; otherwise only adds report-time NMI and ARI, never used for selection.

output_key.description: Prefix of the written members. Existing members with this prefix are replaced only when overwrite is true.

resolutions.description: Grid of resolution values, each greater than 0; the default is the scIB grid. The grid is reported with every result.

selection_rule.description: Rule that picks one resolution: chooser_threshold, max_silhouette (mean silhouette on the embedding), label_nmi (uses labels; comparator only) or report_only (no selection).

chooser_threshold.description: Options of the chooser_threshold rule; ignored by the other rules.

n_subsamples.description: Number of subsamples B. The cost is B times the number of grid values clustering calls.

subsample_fraction.description: Fraction of cells in each subsample, drawn without replacement.

bootstrap_reps.description: Bootstrap replicates for the BCa interval of the median cluster silhouette.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available. CUDA accelerates co-membership counting only.

seed.description: Random seed for subsampling and optimiser tie-breaking.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, peak memory and device without clustering.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members with the same output_key instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/cluster_selected and obs/cluster_selected_res_0.8. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: chosen resolution, cluster count, rule, grid and one row per grid value. Never raw matrices.

chosen_resolution.description: Selected grid value; null for report_only.

n_clusters.description: Cluster count at the selected resolution; null for report_only.

labels_used.description: True when labels_key was set and read.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
